findings.message:
check_dependencies: 1 manifest(s) declare dependencies that no scanner read — osv-scanner reads these only through a lockfile, and there is none:
  - package.json (npm): `npm install` writes package-lock.json (yarn, pnpm and `bun install --save-text-lockfile` also work; bun.lockb does not — it is binary and osv-scanner cannot read it)
These packages were not checked for vulnerabilities at all. Commit the lockfile; deleting one is not a way past this check.

authentication: 3 of 3 endpoint(s) accept requests from anyone who can reach the service — ROUTE /users (app/views.py:6), ROUTE /orders (app/views.py:12), ROUTE /search (app/views.py:18). 1 more is exempt by name and listed separately.
Unauthenticated writes damage a system of record more than unauthenticated reads: a store anyone can append to proves nothing about the records already in it, and an immutable store filled by anonymous writers is a tamper-proof record of unattributable claims. Require a caller identity on every route — `@login_required` (Flask-Login) under the route decorator, a `before_request` hook that refuses a caller who is not signed in, or a check at the top of the view (`abort(401)`). Health and readiness probes are exempt and need no change, as are endpoints whose job is to issue a credential.
sast: command injection — request data reaches a shell command: lib/run.js:4. Pass arguments as a list to a call that does not start a shell, and never build a command string from input.

sast: SQL injection — request data is built into a SQL statement: app/views.py:10, app/views.py:16, app/views.py:22. Use a parameterised query: placeholders in the statement, values passed separately.

advisories.message: check_dependencies: 18 finding(s) at or above high severity — NOT BLOCKING: no lockfile, so osv-scanner resolved minimum-satisfying versions and these may not be what installs. `==` pins in requirements.txt are not enough — they constrain direct dependencies only. Commit a lockfile (for pip: `pip freeze > requirements-lock.txt`) to make this authoritative.
immutability: no append-only store could be identified, so nothing was checked. If this project stores records that must not change, name the table, bucket or collection for what it is

authentication: 1 route(s) exempt by name, not checked — GET /ping (lib/run.js:4, probe). Probe paths (/health, /ping, /metrics and the like) are expected to be open, and an endpoint that issues a credential cannot require it first. The exemption is by path alone: a route with one of these names that reads request input or changes state needs authentication like any other.
kubernetes manifests: not checked — no Kubernetes manifests found, in YAML or in Terraform
retention: not checked — the task states no retention period
code quality: no tests found. The task did not ask for any, so this is not a failure.
